title: Read-only master data cards and templates preflight
purpose: Inspect customer, vendor, item and location card/list/template surfaces before any Universaarl master data is created.

smartDecision.whyNow: TARGET-034 allows only read-only master data preflight. Actual master data creation remains locked while Page 314 and VAT setup are parked.
smartDecision.risk: Clicking New or accepting a template dialog could create a record too early.
smartDecision.fallback: If a page opens a create/template dialog, capture the dialog and close or cancel without confirming.

entryCriteria: TARGET-034 result exists and classifies master data creation as locked but read-only preflight as useful.
Business Central must stay in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
acceptanceCriteria: Customer, Vendor, Item and Location surfaces are classified as readable, blocked, or risky.
Required fields, visible posting-group fields, template prompts and abort logic are documented.
No record is created or edited.
No setup, draft, Preview Posting or Posting occurs.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-034 allows only read-only master data preflight; Page 314 and VAT remain parked.
nextStepDecision.reason: The next practical progress is to understand master data cards/templates without creating records.
